finding.description: The new preprocessing path inherits floating-point ceiling overflow from the unchanged image-sizing helper.
finding.trigger: Call Mistral3VisionModel.get_image_embeddings with a 1541×1000 image and preprocessing longest_edge=1540, patch_size=14, spatial_merge_size=2.
finding.expected_behavior: Resize to a grid-aligned image whose dimensions do not exceed 1540.
finding.actual_behavior: The scalar transcription yields 1568×1008: division rounds the limiting dimension slightly above 1540, ceiling preserves 1541, and alignment raises it to 1568. Neither the helper nor the new caller clamps the result. The parent had no caller of this sizing helper; the task adds a direct preprocessing call reached by get_image_embeddings. The existing example invokes the same interface on Gemma3, so it is not itself evidence of a Mistral3 execution.
